job.name: ig17_host_4
job.meaning: Молодая женщина ~30, светлые волосы, белая рубашка, светлая минималистичная студия, мягкий дневной свет — «чистая, светлая энергия»
job.prompt: Photorealistic photo of a serene Russian woman about 30 with long straight light-blonde hair, a loose white linen shirt, delicate gold earrings, clear calm eyes. FRAMING: vertical 9:16, medium close shot from the chest up, face large and sharp, top of head about 12% below the upper edge, looking straight into the lens, mid-sentence, lips slightly parted, calm, warm, knowing expression, NO broad smile. Look: a real frame from a phone camera, true-to-life colours, natural skin texture, NOT CGI, NOT a glamour retouch. No text, no logos, no watermark. Background: a bright minimal room with white walls, sheer curtains and soft daylight, a green plant softly blurred.
job.person_note: A completely new, ordinary person (not a celebrity, not a model), looks genuinely real.
